Application Data.NAME: Acme Assembly & Packaging Solutions
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Acme Assembly & Packaging Solutions specializes in the assembly and packaging of various consumer products, utilizing advanced machinery and processes to ensure efficiency and quality. Our operations include the careful assembly of components into finished goods, primarily focusing on non-hazardous materials. We have established comprehensive safety training programs for all employees and maintain a robust risk management framework. Our facilities are equipped with modern security systems and are designed to minimize inventory risks, ensuring that products are stored securely and efficiently. We emphasize quality control to prevent product contamination and adhere to all regulatory compliance standards. Additionally, we service a diverse range of clients, providing tailored packaging solutions that meet specific customer requirements.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2022, a minor water leak occurred in the packaging area due to a faulty pipe, causing damage to packaging materials. The estimated loss was $3,500.00, which was resolved swiftly, and materials were replaced without hampering production. Status: Closed. On 09/10/2021, a small electrical fire was reported caused by an equipment malfunction, leading to damages amounting to $9,000.00. No injuries were reported, and the incident was managed efficiently with no business interruption. Status: Closed. Total losses: $12,500.00.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class A, Grade 2 Safe, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing installed around the perimeter of the facility, along with a 24/7 monitored alarm system and regular patrols by security personnel.
